modules.title: 部署结束后，谁继续为用户提供网页
Hosting 和 Deployment 分别负责什么

items.title: Hosting 是持续存在的承载环境
items.text: 它保存静态文件，或持续运行能响应请求的服务；用户通过公网地址请求时，环境负责返回页面或服务结果。

items.title: Deployment 是把版本放进去的动作
items.text: 部署会把某次构建或代码版本发布到托管环境。构建成功或拿到域名，都不能单独证明公网已经提供了正确版本。

modules.title: 容易混淆的地方
modules.text: Hosting 是长期承载网站的环境；Deployment 是一次发布版本的动作；Domain 和 DNS 负责让地址指向某个目标。托管本身不自动提供自定义域名、数据库或正确版本，必须用公网 URL 实际请求验收。

lessonPractice.title: 平台已经分配了运行环境，但公网页面还是旧版本。这个现象更应该先查什么？

options.label: 检查最近一次 Deployment 是否发布了正确版本，并查看公开 URL
options.feedback: 对。承载环境已经存在，旧版本说明发布动作或版本选择可能有问题；先查 Deployment 的输入和结果。

options.label: 再创建一个 Hosting 环境，让两个环境同时提供页面
options.feedback: 已有承载环境时，新增 Hosting 不会说明为什么旧版本被提供；应先检查发布到哪个环境和哪个版本。

options.label: 只更换域名解析，因为域名本身会决定页面版本
options.feedback: 域名和解析决定请求去哪里，不会自动把新版本发布进已有环境；版本问题仍要检查 Deployment。

en.title: The platform has assigned a runtime environment, but the public page still shows the old version. What should you check first?

options.label: Check whether the latest deployment published the right version, then inspect the public URL
options.feedback: Correct. The hosting environment exists, so an old version points to the deployment input or result. Check which version was published where.

options.label: Create another hosting environment and have both serve the page
options.feedback: An existing environment does not explain the old version. First check the target environment and the version used by the deployment.

options.label: Change DNS only because the domain determines which version is served
options.feedback: A domain and DNS direct requests to a destination, but they do not publish a new version into that environment. Check deployment instead.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 请先确认这个项目需要静态文件托管还是持续运行的服务，再部署到对应 Hosting。部署后用公网 URL 请求页面，检查返回的是新版本而不是 localhost；如果仍是旧版，区分 Hosting 环境问题和 Deployment 版本问题。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: First confirm whether this project needs static file hosting or a continuously running service, then deploy it to the matching hosting environment. Request the page through its public URL and verify the new version rather than localhost; if it is still old, separate a hosting-environment issue from a deployment-version issue.

references.title: 什么是 Web 服务器？

learning.assumes: You can open a website locally or have seen a project published to a public address.
learning.outcome: You can distinguish hosting, which continuously serves a site, from deployment, which publishes a version, and verify hosting through a public URL.

modules.title: Who keeps serving the site after deployment ends
What hosting and deployment each do

items.title: Hosting is the persistent environment
items.text: It stores static files or keeps a request-serving service running. When people use a public address, the environment returns the page or service result.

items.title: Deployment is the action that puts a version there
items.text: A deployment publishes one build or code version into the hosting environment. A successful build or a domain alone does not prove the public site serves the right version.

modules.title: What it is not
modules.text: Hosting is the long-lived environment that serves a site; deployment is a version-release action; a domain and DNS direct an address to a target. Hosting does not automatically provide a custom domain, database, or correct version, so verify with a public request.
